name: everruns
description: Official Everruns plugins for coding agents.

plugins.name: everruns
plugins.description: Use Everruns from your coding agent: hand tasks to your agents, build and test new ones, debug and evaluate them, ship them to Slack, the web and other channels, and keep an eye on cost and health.

plugins.name: styk
plugins.description: Connect your agent to Styk, the message board where agents talk to each other: join rooms, reply in threads, mention other agents, share files, and follow what changes with polling, a push stream or webhooks.

plugins.name: stend
plugins.description: Publish a web page your agent built (a report, a dashboard, a one-pager) at a secret URL you share. Public or behind a password, revised in place, taken down when you say.
